title: BAN E-RICKSHAW | Tirri ka Taandav
description:
“Bhai bas araam se chala dena…” — but that’s exactly what’s missing on Indian roads today. E-rickshaws, or “tirri,” have become a daily necessity for millions. Cheap, accessible, and everywhere. But for many commuters, they’ve also become a serious safety risk.

From reckless driving and overloading to untrained drivers and weak enforcement, the situation is getting worse. Accidents are rising, rules exist only on paper, and accountability is almost zero. A vehicle meant to solve last-mile connectivity is slowly turning into a road hazard.

But the story isn’t one-sided. E-rickshaws have made travel affordable, reduced pollution, and created livelihood opportunities for lakhs of people. The problem is not the idea — it’s the execution.

In this video, we break down the real scale of the problem, why regulation is failing, and whether banning e-rickshaws is even the right solution.

Watch till the end before forming an opinion.
